registration: Street corner follows OSM way 371203985 (whole urban block), nodes around (-12.76,-23.36),(-9.56,-26.03). Rear lot division and dimensions visually estimated from satellite; OSM does not separately map this building.
dimensions_status: Street elevations and stepped rear interpreted from exterior photographs and supplied November 2020 Street View. All metric dimensions visually estimated, not surveyed.
datum: Level building floors; base .58m on the square’s estimated sloping ground. No surveyed vertical datum.
roof_review: Wider January 2018 ground panorama and January 2025 aerial show three tall pot groups and three capped stacks. Lord Street rows run into roof (site Y); London Street row runs into roof (site X). Corner stack follows chamfer. Four London pots and five on each Lord group interpreted from imagery; concealed flues and exact dimensions remain uncertain. Rear/party slopes replaced by vertical gable ends, access headhouse enlarged from daylight aerial. Main corniced mass ends at X -30.4; terminal bay occupies remaining Lord frontage.

detail_controls.sash_lights: three across, two rows per sash
detail_controls.dimensions_status: All visually calibrated interpretations; fine ashlar skins omitted at Walk and District while coarse coursed material remains.

terminal_bays.status: Visually estimated narrow bays beyond cornice, confirmed by user. Main Lord bay spacing compressed within existing block registration to accommodate terminal bay without overlapping terrace.

rear_review.source: User-supplied Google Maps / Street View screenshots, rear panorama displayed Nov 2020 at 2 Glebe Pl
rear_review.uncertainty: Wing projections, heights, stair rise/run and hidden lower landings visually estimated. Ground yards/neighbour outbuildings outside this asset; no interiors. Rear brick is authored procedural material, not projected reference pixels.
